svg.aria-label: A legend. Filled circle: the lower voice. Light square with a dark outline: the upper voice. Dashed shape: where a voice started before it moved. Solid bar: a note sounding, as wide as it lasts. Dashed box: a rest, which is silence in that voice. Colour bar: names one pair of notes. Colour belongs to the pair, never to a voice. Numbers on arcs: semitone hops, counting every key, black ones too. Plogger chip: a separate historic lens (outline, shadow, fill). It is not the colour. Note names keep their octave number: B3 and B4 are different keys.
svg.title: How to read our pictures

g.text: Light square with a dark outline: the upper voice.
Dashed shape: where a voice started before it moved.
Solid bar: a note sounding, as wide as it lasts.
Dashed box: a rest, which is silence in that voice.
Colour bar: names one pair of notes. Colour belongs to the pair, never to a voice.
Numbers on arcs: semitone hops, counting every key, black ones too.
Plogger chip: a separate historic lens (outline, shadow, fill). It is not the
Note names keep their octave number: B3 and B4 are different keys.
How to read this graphic: Read this once before the lessons. The two voices are told
apart by shape (circle and square), so the picture still works in black and white.
Colour appears only after a pair has been named, as a bar that belongs to the two notes
